# Online Sunshine - The Florida Legislature

> > Official legal portal providing access to Florida Statutes, the Florida Constitution, and legislative information from the Florida Senate and Florida House of Representatives.

Online Sunshine serves as the primary digital gateway to Florida's legal framework, offering comprehensive access to state laws organized by title and chapter, including traffic laws (Title XXIII, Chapter 316), property tax provisions (Title XIV, Chapter 196), and criminal justice statutes. The portal supports legal research, legislative tracking, and public access to government information.

## Key Topics

- Florida Statutes
- Florida Constitution
- Florida Legislature
- Florida Senate
- Florida House of Representatives
- Title XXIII (Motor Vehicles)
- Chapter 316 (State Uniform Traffic Control)
- Title XIV (Taxation and Finance)
- Chapter 196 (Exemptions)
- Homestead exemption
- Traffic control laws
- Legislative information
- State laws and regulations
- Legal resources

## Getting Started

- [Online Sunshine Homepage](http://www.leg.state.fl.us/Welcome/index.cfm?CFID=243928447&CFTOKEN=74490631): Main portal for accessing Florida Legislature's legal resources, statutes, and legislative information

## Property and Tax Law

- [F.S. 196.031 - Homestead Tax Exemption](https://www.leg.state.fl.us/statutes/index.cfm?App_mode=Display_Statute&URL=0100-0199/0196/Sections/0196.031.html): Requirements and provisions for homestead property tax exemptions in Florida

## Traffic and Motor Vehicle Law

- [F.S. 316.075 - Traffic Control Signal Devices](https://www.leg.state.fl.us/Statutes/index.cfm?App_mode=Display_Statute&URL=0300-0399/0316/Sections/0316.075.html): Rules governing traffic signals, intersection right-of-way, and pedestrian signals

## Criminal Law and Justice

- [F.S. 776.012 - Use of Force in Defense](http://www.leg.state.fl.us/Statutes/index.cfm?mode=View+Statutes&SubMenu=1&App_mode=Display_Statute&Search_String=776.012&URL=0700-0799/0776/Sections/0776.012.html): Stand-your-ground law and provisions for use of force in self-defense situations
- [F.S. 943.0581 - Expunction of Criminal Records](http://www.leg.state.fl.us/statutes/index.cfm?mode=View+Statutes&SubMenu=1&App_mode=Display_Statute&Search_String=943.0581&URL=0900-0999/0943/Sections/0943.0581.html): Administrative procedures for expunging arrest records from criminal history databases
